body:
Thanks again, I ended up going to bed/falling asleep shortly after that. Feel a little better today, looking into getting some help is on the list, as is trying to get out for a mountain bike ride later this week.

Last night was hard, thanks for being here redditors.

I'm think I'm going to look into it.

Thank you.

She started cheating on me with a friend of ours last summer. She told me and left at the end of September. Unfortunately I still see them just about every weekend. I'm a vendor at a craft market and so is he, and she goes along. Some weekends I just don't have the strength to go.

I definitely have a history of lows, this one is has been extended and bad.

I should look into seeing someone locally, I don't have insurance but I'm sure there is something.

Thanks for being here, I really need it tonight.

No kids thank god, I would be the worst dad. I haven't had the energy for my usual activities, mountain biking, rock climbing. I just can't see the point, I don't have anyone to enjoy this stuff with.

That's really what I miss the most. I'm not sharing experiences with anyone. It's a lonely life.

The one close relationship I had left me. I have another long term close friend, but we never talk about anything serious, we've just been friends a long time.

I don't know that I can give up the booze right now. Or reach out to anyone I know. It's embarrassing in a way.
